mentions.name: Sustalium
mentions.description: Sustalium is a compliance and sustainability platform that makes it easier and faster for micro, small, and medium businesses to comply with the majority of compliance and sustainability frameworks, as an alternative to expensive enterprise-level tools.
mentions.problem: Startups and small companies must pay for enterprise-level compliance and sustainability tools just to be considered as suppliers.
mentions.audience: Micro, small, and medium businesses, including startups and small companies
mentions.source_excerpt: So built Sustalium (https://sustalium.com) which is designed to be easier and faster for micro-small-medium businesses to comply with majority of compliance & sustainability frameworks.

evidence.value: So built Sustalium (https://sustalium.com) which is designed to be easier and faster for micro-small-medium businesses to comply with majority of compliance & sustainability frameworks.
